canonical_title: Air vehicle response to direct side force controller/mode

versions.title_at_revision: Air vehicle response to direct side force controller/mode
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's lateral-directional (e.g., lateral nose-pointing, wings-level turn) and lateral-translational response to the direct side force controller/mode is no worse than Level 2 as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Wings-Level Turn paragraph and Lateral Translation paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the air vehicle's lateral-directional and lateral-translational response to the direct side force controller as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Wings- Level Turn paragraph and Lateral Translation paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's lateral-directional and lateral-translational response to the direct side force controller as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Wings-Level Turn paragraph and Lateral Translation paragraph, for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's lateral-directional and lateral-translational response to the direct side force controller as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Wings- Level Turn paragraph and Lateral Translation paragraph, for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
